items.title: 점프 중 받은 식판이 몸을 따라가지 않음
설명으로 끝나는 물건 행동
items.evidence: All ten inventoried explanation-only objects have verified direct manipulation and visible personal results. Per-target deployment/test evidence is recorded below; final pond notebook deployed and checked on Pages38493274558. Item 7 remains pending. This does not resolve other audit items or claim physical-device/student validation.

targets.label: 창가 쉼터
targets.behavior: Walk near the window book stand, open/turn three original picture pages directly, close or walk/jump away; personal device bookmark remains and resumes without rewards or reading-record writes
targets.evidence: tests/library-nook.cjs; tests/campus-connections.cjs; successful Pages38216755106/live bytes; staging b03ae65b34fd0546ea42a7f0a1659de67ecc6cb1 / main-test 962b63445c8bd84a0d00d60a0c632a385f801550; outputs/student-library-nook-deployment.json (2026-09-30/a)

targets.label: 새싹 화분
targets.behavior: Stand beside the sprout and directly swipe its leaves or use the keyboard-equivalent duster; clean leaves and a small care tag remain per account/device. Existing Lv19 observation letter stays separately available, with no reward or letter writes.
targets.evidence: tests/garden-sprout.cjs; tests/garden-letter.cjs; tests/nature-light.cjs; successful Pages38327439822/live bytes; staging688ef4ae1ca5910809b8033d938a9ec7fc3f7937 / main-test5e6427ff288ec49e4c8f566251805238ae1a1128; outputs/student-garden-sprout-deployment.json (2026-09-30/a)

targets.label: 꽃의 자리
targets.behavior: Walk near, pour water directly in world, local account-specific dew/care memory; later petal sway

targets.label: 그늘 쉼터
targets.behavior: Walk to the bench and sit/stand in the world; place a personal pinwheel, swipe or use a key to spin it with a finite slowing turn. Walking/jumping leaves the seat; only toy placement is remembered per account/device, with no rewards.

targets.label: 준비운동 자리
targets.behavior: Walk onto the original mat, swipe left/right/down to directly lean or bend the dressed avatar, or use the equivalent finite keyboard action. Walking/jumping/room/map/account interruptions cancel; a personal device footprint marking remains after use, without school records or rewards.

targets.label: 응원 벤치
targets.behavior: Walk to the original cheering bench, sit/stand, take a small pennant and directly swipe or use a key to wave it with a short cheer. Standing/walking/jumping parks the used flag at the bench; only personal device placement is remembered, with no school records, rewards or shared chat.

targets.label: 함께 쓰는 공
targets.behavior: Walk beside the existing basket, take a small ball, carry it with the dressed avatar while walking/jumping, swipe left/right or use a key to roll it, chase/pick it up and return it. A personal device return tag remains; no rewards, inventory or school records.

targets.label: 관찰 울타리
targets.behavior: Walk beside the existing fence and move an in-scene magnifying window by touch or equivalent keyboard buttons. Three original small neighbours appear enlarged; personal account/device discovery tags remain on the fence. No dialogue quiz, rewards or school-record writes.

targets.label: 물결 관찰대
targets.behavior: Walk beside the existing tripod, directly pan its pond view by swiping or turning a large accessible direction knob. Its optical head turns while the feet remain planted; a visible water bird responds with one bounded wing/ripple animation. A personal device sighting tag and viewing angle remain, with no reward or school record.

targets.label: 질문 노트
targets.behavior: Stand beside the existing desk and directly rub the paper with touch or a bounded keyboard pencil stroke. Only the rubbed parts reveal the leaf. Undo the latest stroke; the exact personal impression remains as a miniature on the desk and resumes on this device/account. No reward or school-record writes.

items.existingActions: Cafeteria sink/table/tray return, parcel delivery, Momo pencil, wardrobe/records and room doors remain functional. One flower interaction does not close item 6.

Native touch, button Enter/Space and the game Space shortcut give one short existing-status message without eating, jumping or saving. Standing restores the normal jump and accessible label. Meal action Space and text input retain their own behavior.

items.evidence: tests/campus-memory-status.cjs and 9 regression suites; staging b01647654c11e4fa8f91bf6cfa9e22866d799d6d / main-test 571c024444f080e89b2d52378e30317a26846bc4; successful Pages 38520997531, live-byte checks and exact main-outside-test preservation. outputs/student-spot-save-feature-deployment.json (2026-09-30/a). items.behavior: A local walking-position save failure shows one short notice and a native keyboard/touch retry beside the controls. Failed positions stay separately per account in session memory; reopening does not jump back to stale storage. Successful retry or the next stopped walk confirms the real local write. Read failure is distinguished and cannot silently overwrite an unread saved position. No idle polling, RPC, reward or school-record changes.

items.title: 식판 놀이 기기 간 이어 하기
items.evidence: tests/cafeteria-memory.cjs (mock and actual dev RPC), tests/cafeteria-memory.sql, concurrent HTTP CAS and 11 regression suites; staging c45dfbf2c8415e31772f44de0d32ea11805cc601 / main-test 8ee88231adf9a97f2d60f8088aa3c7199e432fcb; successful Pages 38667285708, live-byte checks and exact main-outside-test preservation. outputs/student-meal-sync-feature-deployment.json (2026-09-30/a). Native browser touch/keyboard,seven rooms,1366/390/320,reduced/4x CPU emulation; physical Chromebook/pupil observation untested. Item13 next.
items.behavior: Personal meal contents, bites, returns and hand washing resume from the development server across devices. Sitting stays local. Per-account session validation, revision compare-and-swap, idempotent retry and a compact native retry control prevent stale-device overwrite and duplicate returns. Existing device-only data imports only into an empty server record; school rewards are unchanged.

items.behavior: Book jackets use six original line motifs, six high-contrast palettes and a four-grapheme title mark, deterministically derived from the normalized title. Full titles and author/date remain readable; covers are decorative and add no controls, external requests, stored data or rewards.

items.behavior: Each walking NPC keeps one representative errand at the front: teacher uses the existing parcel when eligible or already begun, otherwise walks the player to Momo for the existing pencil favor; Momo keeps pencil progress with shop access; Tori keeps active parcel handoff priority or the available leaf-rubbing favor. Other teacher quests/records/crafting are optional notebook choices. Referral never accepts or completes the other NPC favor remotely.

items.title: 의뢰 수락 표시
items.evidence: tests/request-acceptance.cjs and ten regressions passed; explicit view/accept distinction, device/account acceptance persistence and retry, closed old-account controls, actual existing request loops and economy preserved. Staging 48abbffe9c14a5312eae5bf7f69c11eb5506334d / main-test 3f2502964e527a72d52977254ccacfad08730f08; Pages39192587296,24 exact live files and main-outside-test SHA preservation. outputs/student-request-acceptance-feature-deployment.json (2026-09-30/a). Native browser keyboard/touch,1366/390/320,4x CPU, delayed/error/retry/account/reload and combined memory failure. No DB changes. Physical Chromebook/pupil observation untested; item18 next.
items.behavior: Momo pencil, Tori leaf and parcel distinguish viewing from an accepted request with visible received-request labels. Parcel acceptance is explicit, personal device/account memory, not a server step or an unlock; direct object users accept only when collecting both clues. Local save failures retain current play and provide retries. Closed stale parcel controls cannot accept for a switched account.
